messages.subject: Manual selecting adjustment terms
parts:
Hi all=2C I have a new question about my project. I found a model that fitt=
ed very well to my data organized in manual selected intervals of distance=
=2C in the CDS and MCDS with no covariates. But when adding any of the thre=
e covariates I have (time of survey=2C temperatura and cluster size)=2C the=
shape of the function fitting the data in the detection probability plot c=
hanges a lot=2C and doesn=B4t fit the data at all. Since I want to use the =
same number and values of intervals I selected before=2C I selected the man=
ual entering of the adjustment terms=2C selecting the satarting values fo t=
he two first parameters with the same values I had in my analysis with no c=
ovariates that fitted well the data. This made the model fit well the data=
=2C but I had some warnings after the analysis has been ran saying:" The nu=
mber of starting values for the parameters does not match the number of par=
ameters in the model.The default starting value for parameter A( 3) is bein=
g used instead. **"So I finally had 7 adjustemnt parameters seleced=2C when=
I manually chose to have only three. Is this an important warning to worry=
about? Do I have another way to deal with this?Thank you=2C and hope you u=
nderstand my question=2CregardsTal=EDa
